retrievalProfile.description: A high-glamour disco scene featuring a central figure in metallic gold fringe against a shimmering pink sequin backdrop with a jagged-edge sticker graphic.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, saturated composition centered on a female DJ in a gold fringe outfit, framed by a dense pink sequin background and anchored by a pink DJ booth, featuring a high-contrast blue jagged-edge graphic in the upper left.
coreVisualRelationships: Gold fringe texture against pink sequin grid
Circular DJ booth framing the lower third
Jagged blue sticker contrasting with soft pink tones
Warm skin tones balanced by cool blue graphic accents
coreInvariants: Saturated pink and magenta color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot of a figure from the waist up, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright pink DJ console in the foreground and the blue jagged sticker in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the blue sticker in the top left, down to the subject's face, following the gold fringe to the pink console.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with dense textures and vibrant colors.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Magenta and hot pink (background and console)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with high-key lighting creating specular highlights on sequins.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Round, bubbly, retro-script and clean sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, rounded strokes with interlocking ligatures
Secondary text uses geometric sans-serif with wide tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' dots integrated into adjacent curves
Looping descenders on 'g' or 'y' if present
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bubbly retro display paired with a clean, modern geometric sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Jagged-edge 'starburst' or 'seal' sticker shape in cyan blue

candidateDirections.reason: Provides clean legibility for secondary information

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A woman with a high bun hairstyle wearing a gold fringe dress and headphones, standing behind a pink DJ booth in a room with pink sequin walls.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a cyan blue jagged-edge starburst sticker in the top left corner with white bubbly display text and clean sans-serif metadata inside it.

verificationChecks: Is the background a dense pink sequin texture?
Is the outfit metallic gold fringe?
Is the blue sticker jagged and placed in the corner?
Is the text white and centered in the sticker?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold fringe has a metallic sheen
Verify the pink sequins create a grid-like shimmer
Check that the blue sticker does not obscure the subject's face
Confirm the text is legible against the blue background
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-texture metallic subject with a repetitive geometric background, then anchor with a high-contrast vector sticker overlay.
